$comment: uid is 129 characters, one over the envelope's maxLength of 128. Production uids are CLSCON-<uuid>, 43 characters. Once, a uid over 255 UTF-8 bytes was accepted by the schema and then could not ride as the AMQP messageId, so Input answered 503 on every resend; 128 is also the read contract's bound, so a longer uid was stored and could never be fetched by GET /v1/stats/{type}/{uid}.
